blocks.content:
Legislative Assembly is the lower house and represents the people of the State.

Composition:
• Maximum strength – 500 members
• Minimum strength – 60 members
• Members are directly elected by the people.

Tenure:
• Normal term – 5 years
• Can be dissolved earlier by the Governor.
Legislative Assembly is the lower house and represents the people of the State.

items: Questions often test the maximum (500) and minimum (60) strength limits of the Vidhan Sabha.
Note that the Governor, not the Chief Minister, has the power to dissolve the Legislative Assembly earlier than its 5-year term.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) is the lower house that represents the people of the State.
The composition of the house ranges between a minimum of 60 members and a maximum of 500 members.
Members are directly elected by the citizens of the State.
While the normal term is 5 years, the Governor has the authority to dissolve the Assembly earlier.
